g.text: Source: CMS Medicare Part D Prescribers by Provider and Drug (rows with at least 11 claims), NPPES. Part D reflects diabetes and other covered
uses, not obesity-brand adoption; counts are claims, and only prescribers with 11 or more claims for a drug appear.
